tools.name: get_tip_terms
tools.description: Read free optional tip terms. Discovery never authorizes spending. No wallet or account required.

tools.name: prepare_tip_quote
tools.description: Reserve an UNPAID optional tip quote only with owner permission and budget. Requires a locally generated private capability in the Authorization header. Persist it and the idempotency key first. This tool never signs or pays.

tools.name: get_tip_receipt
tools.description: Read existing private job status or finalized contribution receipt using its original Authorization header. Never creates or retries a payment. includeResult=true requests the result; pending/error is not confirmation.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_tip_quote" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
